Stats table of one module for an ssgt (standings, players, goalies, teams, games)

Source: R/shl.R
shl_stats_info.Rd

Wraps GET https://www.shl.se/api/statistics-v2/stats-info/{module} of the SHL site API (www.shl.se). Unofficial use of a public source; seasons are END years (2026 = 2025/26) and are mapped to the site's ssgt uuids through /statistics-v2/layout-info.

Usage

shl_stats_info(module, season, game_type = "regular", return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

module

Stats module: _

. Every name under layout-info [].filters..modules.
season

Required. Season END year (2026 = 2025/26). Mapped to the provider's ssgt through /statistics-v2/layout-info (SHL 1975/76 on); a season it does not list raises NoDataError.

game_type

Game type: regular (Grundserie), playoff (Slutspel), qualdown (relegation qualification) or playin (2023/24 on).

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON as a list.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE) with the following columns:

col_nametypedescription
rankintegerRank in the table.
gpnumericNumber of games played.
wnumericWins. Team modules (teams_result): total wins, regulation + overtime + shootout; goalkeeper modules: wins credited to the goalie; standings_standings: regulation wins only.
lnumericLosses. Team modules (teams_result): total losses, regulation + overtime + shootout; goalkeeper modules: losses charged to the goalie; standings_standings: regulation losses only.
leadingnumericTimes leading: how often the team was ahead (exact definition unverified).
trailingnumericTimes trailing.
gnumericNumber of goals scored.
ganumericNumber of goals conceded (goals against).
gfgnumericFirst goal of the game.
otwnumericOvertime wins, shootouts excluded (see SOW).
otlnumericOvertime losses, shootouts excluded (see SOL).
sownumericNumber of shootout wins.
solnumericShootout losses.
p_gp_formatnumericPoints per game (formatted). Numeric value sent as a string.
gpgnumericGoals per game. Numeric value sent as a string.
gapgnumericGoals against per game. Numeric value sent as a string.
pointsnumericStandings points (3 per regulation win, 2 per OT/SO win, 1 per OT/SO loss).

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the host answered 404, an empty body (gameday routes before 2023/24), a table with no rows, or the season and game type are not in layout-info. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, a non-JSON or error-envelope 200, a stats-info page that reaches count or falls short of its totalCount, or a body for another game, team, athlete or ssgt than the one asked for. fastRhockey_bad_request: a 400 / 422, a season that is not a year, or an argument outside its choices.
